messages.text:
I’ve created a refund card for both travel items for **BRL 208.00**. The shop’s records show both items were received back (refund-policy/v2/return); the amount is what was paid for them (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Typing “stop” will not cancel it. If you want to cancel the request, use the **cancel button on the card** (refund-policy/v2/approval). To proceed, confirm the exact proposal using the card’s confirmation button.
